reviews.rationale: One existing Engagement route/view composer owns query-derived section selection, current client scope control, meeting-create dialog and delegation to separate domain views. The new outer EngagementScreen admits rich-route unavailable presentation before this composer mounts, so the ordinary client/meeting readers remain outside rich-route handling. The added Outreach key disposes route-bound draft/session local state. No rich DTO, authorization, delivery writer or transport orchestration enters this function. Retain this cohesive composer; its size signal requires exact review, not mechanical splitting.

This existing legacy Outreach list/session selector owns current generic read state and local selection; the new branch prevents a decoded rich candidate or wrong-type marker from entering the plaintext writer, and linked-draft loading/error/ID checks gate presentation. Newsletter parsing remains a pure separate helper and the unavailable receiver has no transport. Cohesion is appropriate for the bounded receiving guard, but initial Back navigation defect requires correction and a fresh exact hash before source acceptance.

Existing plaintext single-record form still owns title/subject/body, generic create/update dispatch and error/busy presentation. Its function syntax is unchanged by this patch; rich records are diverted before it mounts. No rich editing/delivery contract is added. Preserve the existing ordinary-edit assertions; changed enclosing file hash requires renewed whole-file review but not a claim that this function changed.

disposition: Responsibility review only; Back navigation defect remains. Rebind after correction.
